_about: Cards for SHUFFLE. Add a card by copying one block in "cards", giving it the next id, and a category id from "categories". Use \n for a new line. time is shown as written. difficulty is Easy, Medium, or Hard.

cards.title: Bad Ideas Only
cards.description:
Come up with 5 terrible ideas for your event.
Then find one useful element hidden inside them.

cards.title: Steal Like a Leo
cards.description:
Pick an event you loved that had nothing to do with service: a concert, a wedding, a match.
Borrow one thing from it for your project.

cards.title: Ten in Five
cards.description:
Write 10 event ideas in 5 minutes. Quantity beats quality here.
Circle the two that surprise you.

cards.title: Flip the Audience
cards.description:
Redesign your event for a totally different crowd: grandparents, toddlers, or board toppers.
Which idea from that version works for your real audience?

cards.title: The Headline Test
cards.description:
Write the newspaper headline you want the day after your event.
Now plan backwards from it.

cards.title: Silent Storm
cards.description:
Everyone writes one idea anonymously. Shuffle the papers.
Build on someone else's idea, not your own.

cards.title: Yes, And
cards.description:
One person says an idea. Each next person starts with "Yes, and..." and adds to it.
Go around the circle twice.

cards.title: The 5-Word Rule
cards.description:
Describe your entire event in exactly five words.
No more. No less.

cards.title: Three Colours Only
cards.description:
Design your event's look using only 3 colours.
Name each colour after a feeling.

cards.title: The No-Leo Name
cards.description:
Name your event without the words "Leo", "service", or "drive".
Make 5 options, then vote.

cards.title: 30-Second Sketch
cards.description:
Draw your event concept in 30 seconds. No words allowed.
The team guesses what it is.

cards.title: Now Showing
cards.description:
Your event is now a film.
Give it a title, a tagline, and a poster idea.

cards.title: Emoji Brief
cards.description:
Explain your event using only 4 emojis.
Can the rest of the team decode it?

cards.title: Explain It to a 10-Year-Old
cards.description:
Pitch your project to a curious 10-year-old.
No jargon. No acronyms.

cards.title: The Lift Pitch
cards.description:
You share a lift with a company CSR head for 30 seconds.
Pitch your project before the doors open.

cards.title: Exactly Ten Words
cards.description:
Explain your project in exactly 10 words.
Count them out loud.

cards.title: So What?
cards.description:
One person plays a bored stranger who keeps asking "So what?".
Answer until they stop asking.

cards.title: Start With a Person
cards.description:
Open your pitch with one person your project helps.
No numbers in the first sentence.

cards.title: One Post Pitch
cards.description:
Your whole pitch must fit in one 280-character post.
Write it together.

cards.title: Think Small
cards.description:
You have only ₹1,000.
Redesign your event without removing its core purpose.

cards.title: Half the Money
cards.description:
Your budget was just cut by 50%.
What stays, what goes, and what gets smarter?

cards.title: Sky's the Limit
cards.description:
Imagine money is no problem. What would you add?
Now find a free way to get 20% of that.

cards.title: Borrow, Don't Buy
cards.description:
List everything your event needs. Mark each item: buy, borrow, or sponsor.
Try to buy fewer than half.

cards.title: The ₹100 Question
cards.description:
One participant's experience costs ₹100.
Where does every rupee go? Split it out.

cards.title: In-Kind Hunt
cards.description:
Pick your biggest expense.
Name 3 local businesses that could give it in kind instead of cash.

cards.title: Scroll Stopper
cards.description:
Write 3 opening lines for a post that would stop a thumb mid-scroll.
Keep the best one.

cards.title: No Poster Allowed
cards.description:
Promote your event without a single poster.
What do you do instead?

cards.title: The First 3 Seconds
cards.description:
Plan a Reel whose first 3 seconds make people stay.
Describe the exact shot.

cards.title: Who Hits Share?
cards.description:
Name 5 people or pages who would share your post.
Why would each of them want to?

cards.title: Countdown Plan
cards.description:
Plan one post for each of the 3 days before your event.
Each one must give a new reason to come.

cards.title: The Tell-a-Friend Line
cards.description: Write the one sentence you want a participant to say to a friend after the event.

cards.title: Replace One Thing
cards.description:
Replace one part of your event with something unexpected.
Keep it if the event gets better.

cards.title: The First Five Minutes
cards.description: Plan exactly what a participant sees, hears, and does in the first five minutes.

cards.title: Walk the Route
cards.description:
Trace a participant's path from arrival to exit.
Find one moment where they wait with nothing to do. Fix it.

cards.title: It's Raining
cards.description:
It starts raining 1 hour before your event.
What is your plan B?

cards.title: The Photo Moment
cards.description: Design one moment that everyone will want to photograph.

cards.title: Cut 30 Minutes
cards.description:
Your event must be 30 minutes shorter.
What goes? Does it get better?

cards.title: Role Swap
cards.description:
Everyone takes the role of the person on their left.
Plan the next step from their point of view.

cards.title: Strength Map
cards.description:
Each person names one skill of the person on their right.
Match one event task to it.

cards.title: The Quiet Round
cards.description: For 3 minutes, only the people who have spoken least may suggest ideas.

cards.title: Joy Match
cards.description:
Each person shares two things they enjoy doing.
Pick one event task that uses them.

cards.title: Volunteer's Shoes
cards.description:
Plan the volunteer experience.
What will they learn, enjoy, and take home?

cards.title: Praise First
cards.description:
Before anyone disagrees with an idea, they must say one good thing about it.
Keep this rule for 5 minutes.

cards.title: What Could Go Wrong?
cards.description:
Name one thing that could go wrong.
Now design a solution before you move on.

cards.title: Five Whys
cards.description:
Take your biggest problem and ask "why?" five times.
Solve the last answer, not the first.

cards.title: Plan to Fail
cards.description:
How would you make this event fail completely?
Flip each point into a rule you will follow.

cards.title: One Phone Call
cards.description:
You can make one call to fix your biggest problem.
Who do you call, and what do you ask?

cards.title: Zero Resources
cards.description:
Solve your problem with no money, no new people, and one week.
What is still possible?

cards.title: The Day After
cards.description:
It is the day after your event, and it flopped.
Write 3 reasons why. Fix them today.

cards.title: Before and After
cards.description:
Describe one beneficiary's day before and after your project.
What actually changed?

cards.title: Count What Counts
cards.description:
Pick 3 numbers you will measure on event day.
How will you collect each one?

cards.title: Three Months Later
cards.description:
What will still be different 3 months after your event?
If nothing, redesign one part.

cards.title: In Their Words
cards.description: Write one question you will ask beneficiaries to hear the impact in their own words.

cards.title: The Ripple
cards.description:
Your event helps 50 people. Who do they help next?
Draw the ripple.

cards.title: Dignity Check
cards.description:
Walk through your plan as the people you serve.
Is any moment awkward? Change it.

cards.title: Time Machine
cards.description:
Plan your event as if it were 1995. Then as if it were 2050.
Bring one idea back to today.

cards.title: Switch the Cause
cards.description:
Your event is now for a different cause.
Which part of the plan still works perfectly?

cards.title: Star Guest
cards.description:
Any famous person agrees to attend. Who, and what would they do?
How can you get 10% of that effect?

cards.title: Add a Game
cards.description:
Turn one part of your event into a game.
Add points, a timer, or a prize.

cards.title: Mystery Box
cards.description: Add one surprise that participants discover only on the day.

cards.title: Speak Human
cards.description: Rewrite your event description without the words "awareness", "initiative", or "community".
